name: homeopathway-clinical-dashboard-server
description: Production-oriented full-stack EMR, telehealth and clinical publishing platform for Homeopathway.

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build && cp -r out/* ../public/
scripts.test:syntax: node --check server.js && node --check blog-api.js && node --check emr-api.js && node --check telehealth-api.js && node --check ops-api.js && node --check security-bootstrap.js
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend && npm ci && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.quality: npm run test:syntax && npm run security:audit && npm run migration:check && npm run emr:contract && npm run typecheck && npm run build
